# 0.11.0 — Tenant query validation

7 October 2026. Minor on **0.10.0**.

Bare `validate query` no longer scans. `--live` is the tenant check. Regenerate CI with `opentide setup ci` so generated pipelines pass `--live` and pin this release. Regenerate schemas with `opentide generate` so optional vocabulary lists include `items.enum`.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.11.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Changed

- Bare `opentide validate query` refuses and names `--live`. `--live` checks the tenant. A missing SDK or plan fails that check. CrowdStrike and HarfangLab stay unsupported ([#456](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/456)).
- Generated GitHub, GitLab, and Azure pipelines pass `--live` and skip a platform when its credential variables are empty ([#456](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/456)).
- MCP `validate_query` refuses unless `live` is true ([#456](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/456)).
- Generated schemas stamp `items.enum` on optional vocabulary lists ([#450](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/450)).
- `opentide generate` runs several named phases in one invocation ([#455](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/455)).
- The bundled actors vocabulary matches the specifications snapshot from the live MISP galaxy ([specifications#34](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/specifications/issues/34)).

## Fixed

- Validation findings print `file:line` when `yaml_line` is set ([#451](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/451)).
- `validate --check` returns only that check's issues ([#452](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/452)).
- Unknown `sharing.toml` keys name `[[misp]]` ([#453](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/453)).
- Surface suggestions try the exact de-prefixed key before difflib ([#454](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/454)).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide validate query --help
```

Expect `0.11.0`.
